messages:
alex: FYI starting onboard for phoenix-13b weights -> location s3://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-13b/v1/weights.tar.gz. tokenizer appears to split emojis into weird tokens in sentencepiece. Anyone seen this?

mira: thanks, alex. Can you paste model config? Also we should validate config.yml before bench.

alex: pasted snippet:

```
model:
  name: phoenix-13b
  dtype: fp16
  seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache: true
```

jonas: tokenizer file at same path? s3://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-13b/v1/tokenizer.json

sophia: I noticed the tokenizer has two unk tokens in vocab causing duplicated ids — leads to off-by-one in embedding lookup. Quick fix: run vocab dedupe script: tools/tokenizer/dedupe_vocab.py --input tokenizer.json --output tokenizer.clean.json

alex: ran dedupe, still seeing weird subword splits for emojis and URLs causing longer sequence length -> affects batching. Example: "http://x.com" tokenizes to 18 tokens.

mira: profiling note: when batch_size>=8 p99 jumps. We need to run perf sweep: bs 1,2,4,8,16 with seq=512/1024. Can someone run on test-pool-rtg?

jonas: I'll queue perf runs tonight. Using run_bench.sh --model phoenix-13b --weights s3://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-13b/v1/weights.tar.gz --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-13b/v1/tokenizer.clean.json --bs [1,2,4,8,16] --seq [512,1024] --quant q4_0

perf-bot: queued job 4729 by jonas on test-pool-rtg, ETA 3h, notify #eng-ml on completion.

sophia: heads-up: quant q4_0 might change tokenization behavior? unlikely but log both tokenizer outputs and token counts per request.

alex: also config validation blew up earlier: "invalid dtype fp16 on quantized path" workaround is to set dtype: auto in config, runtime will choose int8 path. putting here for awareness.

mira: can infra-bot pin weights to dedicated cache? We want to avoid S3 warmup during bench.

infra-bot: pin request received for s3://redwood-models/onboard/phoenix-13b/v1/weights.tar.gz to test-pool-rtg cache. TTL 12h. Done.

jonas: thanks. I'll annotate bench notes with tokens-per-request and first-token latency.

sophia: after bench, if p99>150ms for bs<=4 we should try reducing kv cache prefetch or adjust kernel selection.

alex: will open a PR with config.yml changes and tokenizer.clean.json attached. Ping @mira for quick review.

mira: will review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: job 4729 completed. summary: bs1 seq512 p99=85ms, bs4 seq512 p99=160ms, bs8 seq512 p99=290ms, tokenization inflated seq by ~1.2x for URLs. Full logs: https://perf.redwood/jobs/4729

jonas: uploading logs and helm config used to thread. Added notes about dedupe step.

sophia: great. Next steps: 1) try tokenizer.vocab trim, 2) rerun bs sweep, 3) validate config auto-dtype + quant. I'll take (1) and (2) if someone approves.

alex: approved. thanks all.
